text: May is my mum's mum. Who is May? Pick one.
May is my grandmother.
Dan is my dad's dad. Who is Dan? Pick one.
Dan is my grandfather.
May and Ben are my mum's mum and dad. Who are they? Pick one.
May and Ben are my grandparents.
Sue is my dad's mum. Who is Sue? Say a full sentence.
She is my grandmother.
Tom is my mum's dad. Who is Tom? Say a full sentence.
He is my grandfather.
Ann and Dan are my dad's mum and dad. Who are they? Say a full sentence.
They are my grandparents.
My house has a red door. It has three bedrooms. What is it about? Pick one.
It is about a house.
I have a toy car and a toy train. I play with them every day. What is it about? Pick one.
It is about toys.
My mum and dad and I eat together. We help each other. What is it about? Pick one.
It is about a family.
Our house has a blue door. We sleep and eat in it. What is it about? Say a full sentence.
It is about a house.
My toy plane is blue. I play with my toy cars too. What is it about? Say a full sentence.
It is about toys.
My brother and I live with our mum and dad. We love each other. What is it about? Say a full sentence.
It is about a family.
